description: Step 8: Place a test call. Ring `to` from the business's RingKit number with the AI receptionist (a real call, billed at the AI rate). `to` must be configured on the business (ownerPhone, a transfer target or an SMS notify target) and verified. Ask the human to answer and talk to it like a caller. A retried identical call returns the same result; pass a new idempotencyKey to ring again. Identical requests are deduplicated for 24 hours; use a new idempotencyKey only to deliberately repeat the action.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_test_call
title: Place a test call
